_comment: Controls the Collaborations cards. Edit this file, not the generated SVGs. The workflow regenerates everything on a schedule.

rules._comment: A repo counts as a collaboration when I have at least minMyCommits commits AND some other human has at least minTheirCommits. Bots never count as humans.

alwaysInclude._comment: Repos to keep even if the rules above reject them. Useful when my commits sit on a branch the contributors API ignores.
alwaysInclude.Alaika10/strukly_AI_UMKM: My commits are on the Model-AI branch, so the contributors API reports zero for me.

manualRepos._comment: Repos the API cannot discover. A fine-grained token only sees resources owned by me, so private repos belonging to other people are invisible to it. Swap COLLAB_TOKEN for a classic token with the 'repo' scope and these get picked up automatically instead, at which case live data wins over what is written here.

entries.desc: Eco-tech waste app. I built the Gemini Live AI camera scan and the realtime voice and video assistant.
A bullet-heaven roguelite set inside a computer. I built the character select screen, UI assets, and enemy fixes.

alwaysExclude._comment: Repos the rules would accept but that should not appear.
alwaysExclude.GianneAngely/PERINTIS: Same project as Prisma-Competition-2025-Rantau. Listing both would double-count the same work.
alwaysExclude.GianneAngely/LUMINA: I have zero commits in it.

overrides._comment: Custom card copy. 'desc' replaces the repo description, which is what makes these read as portfolio entries instead of generic blurbs.
